note: Generated file — do not edit. Regenerate with `tools/lab format sync`; `tools/lab validate` fails if it has drifted from the code.

feed_classes.news: homepage news column; eligible for RSS
feed_classes.activity: project activity timeline only; never RSS
feed_classes.none: chart data; never a feed item

provenance.note: Which model produced a piece of work — two facts, kept apart: `requested` is what the launcher asked for (LAB_MODEL, else .claude/loop.conf as it reads today), `served` is what actually answered, read from the Claude Code session transcript. loop.conf is current config, edited over a project's life — never the answer by itself.
provenance.session_end: session.end event -> data {requested, requested_source, served, served_source}
provenance.trial: <trial_dir>/config.json -> agent {requested, requested_source, served, served_source} (served as of trial launch)
provenance.run_final: run.done event -> data.models (frozen with the verdict)

sources.transcript: served: read from the session transcript — the record of what answered, fallbacks and switches included
sources.env: requested: recorded by the session that ran (LAB_MODEL)
sources.conf: requested: reconstructed from .claude/loop.conf as it reads today — a guess
sources.none: unknown; requested is the string 'unknown', served is []

provenance.display: models is {started_with, by_phase, sources}. by_phase values are ordered lists — more than one entry means a fallback or mid-session switch; show them all. started_with may be null: render it as unknown, never as a default model. sources within {transcript, env} is a record; any conf or none means partly reconstructed, and a consumer should say so.

trial.note: summary.md is written when the trial ends, including when killed.
